resources.string: Ping, jitter, download and upload via Cloudflare
Server location is shown once the test starts.
Connect to Wi-Fi, mobile data or Ethernet to run the test.

This connection is metered. On a fast connection the test can use up to about %1$s MB (each phase stops at 10 seconds or 100 MB). On slower connections it uses much less.

All saved speed test results will be deleted from this device. This cannot be undone.
Results depend on the Cloudflare server, your network and the moment you test. Cloudflare sees your IP address, as any website does.

How it works: Able measures against Cloudflare's public speed test (speed.cloudflare.com), the same service its website uses.

Ping and jitter: 10 tiny requests after one warm-up request. Ping is the median round trip, without Cloudflare's own processing time; jitter is the average change between consecutive pings.

Download and upload: 4 parallel transfers that grow from 100 kB to 1 MB, 10 MB and 25 MB as the connection allows. Each phase stops after 10 seconds, earlier once the speed is stable, or when its data budget is reached (100 MB on metered connections). The first second is excluded so connection set-up does not lower the result. Speeds are in megabits per second (1 Mbps = 1,000,000 bits per second).

Data used: shown during and after the test. On mobile data Able asks before starting.

Privacy: Able contacts speed.cloudflare.com only. Cloudflare sees your IP address like any website. Results are saved only on this device (last 20) and never uploaded.
